correctness.rationale: The full proof reconstructs all transitions for the contiguous blue cycle block, with the distinct m=1 boundary, uniquely solves three rational generating functions, handles the initial single-core state and final deterministic leaf round, and shows the leaf-start gap is strictly positive. Algebraic rational identities were independently checked and the original 2n-state Markov chain was solved exactly for n=5,6; 653 exact comparisons pass. The finite checker is not treated as an infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Chan et al. (2019/2020), the exact same-model source, publish an n-dependent Markov computation and conjecture the 11/16 limit rather than proving an all-size finite formula. Related 2018 exact path/cycle formulas and the 2019/2025 general bounds do not cover this n-Sun identity or the strict start-orbit classification. Actual semantic, exact-phrase, equivalence and published-source searches returned no stronger covering result; undiscovered priority remains possible.
residual_risks: Unindexed or inaccessible studies may independently solve the 2019 sun-graph conjecture or give an equivalent recurrence evaluation.
The source's generic finite Markov inversion is computationally universal but not a published symbolic theorem for the entire sunlet family.
No independent historical-priority review has been performed.

value.rationale: Closes a specific published natural-probability conjecture with a genuinely all-size formula, identifies two distinct alternating geometric correction modes, and proves cycle rather than pendant-leaf starts are optimal for every n>=5. It supplies exact finite-size expectation values beyond a numerical table and makes the limiting increment transparent.
